name: zc_make_additive_material

tests.name: the project has its own additive material
it is additive, unlit, and allowed on instanced static meshes

detail.note: the InstancedStaticMeshes flag is the one the engine material is missing, and it is why the halos were being replaced by the default material in game

tests.name: and it carries the Color parameter the figures already write

detail.note: the embodiment dresses every instance through SetVectorParameterValue('Color')
